gunner.name: Orc Gunner
gunner.subtitle: the village pot-mender
gunner.lore: He used to mend pots in the village. Still carries the little brass hammer, though there's no one bringing him pots now. The gun belonged to his father. He keeps it wrapped against the damp and counts his shot every morning. I put him near the entrance. He's someone I want to see when I come back.
gunner.note: Give him a bend in the road. Frosted Rogues are easy targets; Paladin plate stops most of his shot.

cannonier.name: Cannonier
cannonier.subtitle: a stolen guild cannon
cannonier.lore: They took the cannon off a guild wagon. Getting it down the Rotunda stairs cost us a door, three steps and most of an afternoon. The small one loads; the big one aims. Both claim to be in charge. I've given up settling it. I do wish they'd warn me before they fire indoors.
cannonier.note: Break Paladin plate and catch packed ranks in the blast. Splash also catches evasive Rogues.

frost.name: Frost Mage
frost.subtitle: from the northern passes
frost.lore: She came down from the northern passes with a split boot and frost in her hair. Asked for somewhere dry to sleep. I gave her the old gardener's room, and she spent the next day clearing rubble with us. Her hands leave white marks on the shovel. We've wrapped the handle twice. She hasn't complained about the room.
frost.note: Frost removes Rogue evasion while the slow lasts. Place a gunner, Ranger or slingers where they can follow up.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.subtitle: watching the caravan road
ranger.lore: I knew her by her arrows before I knew her face. Green thread below the fletching, heads hammered from scrap iron. We'd find them in wolves along the caravan road. She came looking for the families who travelled it. I had no good news for her. She stayed to help me watch the road anyway.
ranger.note: A Centurion's magic ward will not stop her arrows. Against Paladins, mix her arrows with siege fire.

lightning.name: Lightning Mage
lightning.subtitle: a weather-worker's apprentice
lightning.lore: He was apprenticed to a weather-worker before the guild burned their tower. Most of his books went with it. He's been writing what he remembers on the backs of our supply lists, with corrections squeezed into the margins. I keep finding them under things. Don't throw them out. He needs the paper, and I need the lists.
lightning.note: Lightning bypasses Paladin plate and Rogue evasion, but Centurion wards cut its damage by 80%.

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.subtitle: built from bridge oak
trebuchet.lore: I helped build this one. Good bridge oak, iron straps from the city gates, a sling we had to sew again after the first throw. Finding stones is half the work. The crew won't take anything without a decent weight to it, so I spend my evenings hauling rocks for them to argue over. My back misses carpentry.
trebuchet.note: Full damage through Paladin plate, with a wide blast that catches evasive Rogues. Give the crew a long view.

gnolls.name: Gnoll Slingers
gnolls.subtitle: rat-catchers and chicken thieves
gnolls.lore: They arrived with stolen chickens and wanted to know who owned the tunnels. Malgrath said he did. They asked whether that included the rats. Took a while to explain what we actually needed. Now one picks stones while the other practises, and they swap whenever they start fighting. They've asked me to keep count of the helmets they dent.
gnolls.note: Keep them close to the path. Frost helps them hit Rogues; their stones do little against Paladin plate.

runeforge.name: Runeforge
runeforge.subtitle: aim it down the road
runeforge.lore: The focusing stone came out of Malgrath's old furnace. He charged us for it. We built the casing from scrap brass, and I worked the bellows while the mages argued about the runes. Burned a hole through three practice shields. It needs a straight shot, though. Someone has to stop it pointing at the pantry.
runeforge.note: Aim down a lane; r rotates. The beam damages every fighter along it. Frost holds them in the heat. Magic bypasses plate, but Centurion wards resist it. One per level; selling frees the slot.

hookmaster.name: Ogre Hookmaster
hookmaster.subtitle: hauling them back
hookmaster.lore: He used to haul barges through the shallows. Brought his own chain, which was fortunate because ours snapped on the first pull. I asked him to keep fighters away from the inner gate. He asked where I wanted them put. We've marked the road with chalk. He's very particular about getting them back to the mark.
hookmaster.note: Pulls fighters backward along the road. Plate and wards make heavy fighters harder to move; champions barely budge. Fighters recover between pulls, even against several Ogres. Each fighter can only be dragged so far before it resists further pulls. One per level; selling frees the slot.

sappers.name: Goblin Sappers
sappers.subtitle: mind where you step
sappers.lore: They wanted a dry cupboard for the powder and a separate one for lunch. I was pleased about that until I found out they meant my cupboard. Their mines are made from old kettles. Each has a little brass catch the crew checks before leaving it on the road. They made me practise lifting an unarmed one first.
sappers.note: The crew plants a limited stock of mines on nearby road tiles, even between waves. Explosions bypass plate and evasion. Recruits can waste the charges. Selling the crew removes its mines. One per level; selling frees the slot.

witch.name: Hex Witch
witch.subtitle: choosing who falls first
witch.lore: She asked for a lock of the champion's hair. I explained that getting close enough was the difficulty. A name would do, she said. We tried the names the guild shouted up the stairs until one worked. Now she keeps a little notebook beside her chair. I've asked her to leave our names out of it.
witch.note: Marks a fighter to take more damage from every defender. Marks do not stack or remove plate and wards. Strongest targeting helps focus the curse on champions. One per level; selling frees the slot.
